Few people have skills to setup such a service, some don’t have needed hardware, and others don’t share the desire. If a requirement to contribute to OSM is having to setup their own private Overpass server, they’ll just move on to other things.

For others, setting up their own private Overpass server is not even an option because they use other tools which use Overpass, and those tools can’t be re-targeted to a different server(ie Relatify or PTNA).
